title: Bowman Debuts at #14 on BD+C’s Top Engineering Firms List
summary: Bowman debuts on BD+C's 2026 Top Engineering Firms list, marking its first appearance in the publication’s Giants 400 Report.
body_markdown:
Bowman has earned its first-ever placement on Building Design+Construction’s (BD+C)[Top Engineering Firms list](https://www.bdcnetwork.com/giants-400/article/55399606/top-80-engineering-firms-for-2026) , debuting at #14 in the publication’s 2026 Giants 400 Report.


The annual Giants 400 Report ranks the nation’s largest architecture, engineering and construction firms serving the building sector. BD+C’s Top Engineering Firms list recognizes leading engineering firms based on their work across nonresidential building and multifamily housing markets.


Bowman’s strong debut reflects the continued growth and breadth of our engineering capabilities across the built environment. From civil and structural engineering to MEP, commissioning and other specialized services, our multidisciplinary teams work together to support projects through an increasingly integrated approach.


This first-time recognition adds to Bowman’s growing presence among the industry’s leading firms and reflects the expertise of our teams, continued investment in our capabilities and commitment to delivering comprehensive solutions that create lasting value for our clients.
